name: Jwalantam Karalam
meaning: A praise of Narasimha’s fierce yet protective form, his great power, and his ability to bestow peace and protection.
note: The wording in the client list could not be matched to a published verse; it is held back until it is checked.
supplied:
Jwalantam Karalam Maha Shaktim
Narasimham Bheeshanam Bhadra Murtim
Anugraham Shanthim Isham Namami
Sarva Raksha Karam Deva Devam
